svg.title: OrientMatch coarse-to-fine pose search
svg.desc: The coarse stage scores every position for every coarse angle on a half-resolution image. The best K poses are refined at full resolution over a small position window and neighbouring angles, which costs a small fraction of an exhaustive full-resolution search.
svg.text: Why the search is split in two stages
the score is a 3-D volume over (x, y, θ) — sample all of it cheaply, then look closely only where it is promising
STAGE 1 coarse — all positions × all 3° angles, on the 0.5× image
one complete translation score map per coarse angle — 120 of them
best score found at each coarse angle
cheap because the image, the template and the angle grid are all coarse
STAGE 2 fine — full resolution, only around those poses
position score map at full resolution
the coarse peak is at best
What that buys, on this example
Counted as template pixels × evaluated poses. This is a heuristic: a narrow score peak that the coarse grid misses cannot be recovered by the fine stage.
